verdict.rationale: Framer's docs describe staging environments for testing changes on a framer.app domain before going live. They also describe branching that keeps the main project untouched, and say every external-agent change automatically lands on a reviewable branch that you merge when ready, with publishing kept under user control. Together these let an AI-native user trial agent work away from the live site. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CMS data writes are isolated on branches or staging rather than shared with production; a sandbox or test mode for the Server API; independent or hands-on corroboration.
